name: Ololand Forensic Qoe
description: Forensic Quality-of-Earnings primitives as a standalone Claude plugin: Beneish M-Score, Benford's Law, EBITDA bridge, journal-entry testing, lapping detection, and working-capital deep dive. Wraps OloLand's deterministic forensic engines as the Pre-LOI Forensic Screen wedge ($7,500 / 72 hours, IC-defensible). Sells against Big-4 QoE ($150-500K, 4-8 weeks).
longDescription:
Ships **10 skills**, **9 commands** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (10): `cmd-beneish` (Use when the user asks to run the OloLand /beneish workflow), `cmd-benford` (Use when the user asks to run the OloLand /benford workflow), `cmd-conflicts` (Use when the user asks to run the OloLand /conflicts workflow), `cmd-ebitda-bridge` (Use when the user asks to run the OloLand /ebitda-bridge workflow), `cmd-forensic-screen` (Use when the user asks to run the OloLand /forensic-screen workflow), `cmd-journal-test` (Use when the user asks to run the OloLand /journal-test workflow), `cmd-lapping-check` (Use when the user asks to run the OloLand /lapping-check workflow), `cmd-legal-risk` (Use when the user asks to run the OloLand /legal-risk workflow), and 2 more
- **Commands** (9): `beneish` (Run the Beneish M-Score (private-company adjusted) on a deal's financials to estimate earnings-manipulation probability), `benford` (Run Benford's Law first-digit testing on a deal's general-ledger transactions to detect numeric fabrication or selective entry), `conflicts` (Run OloLand''s Deal Document Conflict Detector across a deal''s data room — surfaces cross-document discrepancies (mismatched figures, dates,…), `ebitda-bridge` (Build the EBITDA bridge with an adjustment classifier — categorizes every add-back as one-time, pro-forma, or questionable and…), `forensic-screen` (Run a Pre-LOI Forensic Screen — full battery of Beneish M-Score, Benford's Law, EBITDA bridge, journal-entry testing, lapping…), `journal-test` (Run journal-entry anomaly testing — period-end concentration, round-number frequency, weekend/holiday entries, and unusual posting patterns), `lapping-check` (Detect AR-lapping fraud patterns — receivables-cycle anomalies indicating that customer payments are being applied to wrong invoices to…), `legal-risk` (Analyze sourced covenant clauses and merger-agreement MAC/MAE language with page-level quotes and risk classification), and 1 more
- **MCP servers** (1): `ololand`

Installs with `claude plugin install ololand-forensic-qoe@claude-community` from `ololand-ai/ololand-plugins` (`plugins/ololand-forensic-qoe`).
